UAL Level 3 Diploma and Extended Diploma in Creative Practice: Fashion Design
UAL Level 3 Diploma and Extended Diploma in Creative Practice: Fashion Design

This fashion and textiles course equips you with industry-standard techniques and practical skills using professional workshops, studio and digital design software. You’ll be taught by experience industry professionals to develop your creative vision through: 

  • Fashion and costume research – become competent researching the history of fashion and costume and how to use this to inspire your own designs 
  • Fashion design and construction – learn how to design, pattern cut and construct unique garments, from concept to finished product  
  • Costume design and construction – Understand and practice the specialist skills required in costume design, construction, embellishment and performance  
  • Textile design – from initial ideas to final designs – tell a story through textile designs using a variety of mediums 
  • Props for theatre & film – learn prop-making techniques for stage and screen productions 
  • Digital design – build a portfolio of styling, branding and visual storytelling using Adobe Creative Cloud 
  • Sustainability in fashion & costume – discover how to work as an ethical, environmentally conscious designer 

Through lectures, workshops, industry briefs and live projects, you’ll refine your craft in our specialist sewing, textile and prop-making workshops, photography studios and IT suites. 

Industry Experience & Enrichment 

We believe in hands-on experience, giving you the chance to: 

  • Work on live industry briefs, designing costumes and props for theatrical productions and fashion editorials 
  • Exhibit your work in professional showcases  
  • Collaborate with industry professionals, gaining insight from guest speakers and theatre practitioners, including Chelmsford Theatre 
  • Create your own professional website and brand identity to launch your career 

We also offer exciting field trips, with past experiences including: 

  • Theatre shows, backstage and costume department tours 
  • Harry Potter Studio Tour & cinema screenings 
  • Visits to The Fashion & Textile Museum and The Victoria & Albert Museum 
  • Leading London exhibitions and galleries

This course prepares you for a diverse range of careers in the fashion, costume, and creative industries, equipping you with highly sought-after skills. Whether you want to go straight into employment, start your own business or continue studying, you’ll have plenty of options, including: 

  • Entry-level job roles, apprenticeships or freelance work in fashion design, costume design, theatre prop-making, styling, branding and digital marketing 
  • Progressing to Level 4 in Creative Enterprise – delivered at Chelmsford College 
  • UCAS-recognised qualification, enabling you to apply for BA degree courses in Fashion, Costume Design, Theatrical Arts, Creative Direction, Set & Prop Design and many more 

This course is your pathway into the world of fashion, theatre, and creative storytelling — are you ready to bring your vision to life?

There are a range of assessment methods across the course - internal and external.

Internal assessments are assessed using a variety of styles including writing up findings of research, using case studies to explore different situations, carrying out projects and demonstrating practical skills.

External assessments are either examinations – all learners take the same assessment at the same time, normally with a written outcome.

Set tasks – learners take the assessment during a defined window and demonstrate understanding through completion of a vocational task.

The external units must be achieved at a Pass or above and learners are only permitted to re-sit the assessment once during their study programme.
